The '''Vampire Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be obtained as a reward from [[Gil]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after completing the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] of killing 200 [[Bats]].  After that, it can be purchased from Marlon for {{Price|15000}}.

The Vampire Ring restores 2 [[health]] after slaying a monster.<ref name="effect" />

Effects from multiple Vampire Rings stack. When equipped with multiple Vampire Rings, each will provide 2 points of health restoration for every monster slain.<ref name="stacking" />

==Dyeing==
The Vampire Ring can be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
